II-II q.51 a.4.text: Whether gnome (judging well according to general law) is a special virtue? ... it is necessary to have a higher virtue of judgment, which is called gnome ... which denotes a certain discrimination in judgment.
II-II q.51 a.4.notes: Gnome judges cases that fall outside the common rules, by higher principles. Ch. 11's 'virtue for exceptional cases'.
